summary: Both halves of the multi-voter question now have complete comparisons with controls. Receipt abfdbd1823b342409ef4a815bade0407 resolves the election check: with RestoreCommittedLogs on and the restarted node isolated together with one committed voter immediately after NewRaft returns, it became leader with reachable_votes 2 against a committed quorum of 3 (comparison 0 violated, witness event index 22), and the same run shows the majority side still holding a leader, so a leader elected on a minority of the committed configuration coexisted with it; the flag-off control never won (holds, evaluated index 25). Together with receipt b15f4b6c55b44402ace926204de9b826 for the configuration loss (witness index 15, control index 18), the child question is answered as violated with defect_claim asserted: the stale rebuilt configuration both misdescribes membership and decides an election the committed configuration would refuse, which matters because a client applying through that leader would receive success for an entry lacking a majority of the committed configuration. A Behavior knowledge entry is promoted for the minority leadership with that receipt, the schedule dependence is retained as counterevidence with an explicit mechanism (requestVote's existing-leader guard, raft.go:1690-1700), no frequency or absence is claimed, and the two redundant incomplete config re-checks in the last declaration are noted as carrying no new claim. The registered gap stays open only on entry-level divergence or a lost acknowledged entry, which is not witnessed.
